description: Pedestrian Space Added is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. Pedestrian space are added between roadways and at sidewalk curbs to increase pedestrian safety as well as traffic calming. The added pedestrian spaces allows accessibility and mobility for pedestrians at high traffic volume locations. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category City Government. Its tags are medians, walk, plaza, space, pedestrian. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Transportation (DOT). The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
